fact: Zambia and Mozambique officially launched the Chanida-Cassacatiza cross-border fibre-optic interconnector, linking Zambia's national backbone to Mozambique's submarine-cable network, at a commissioning ceremony reported on 2026-02-23 (Zambia's technology minister and Mozambique's communications minister speaking); the date is the document's published date.
source_slug: 2026-02-23 Zambia and Mozambique launch fibre-optic interconnector at Chanida–Cassacatiza border

fact: MoRENet staff said its international capacity expanded from 5 to 60 Gbps via a new border PoP in Cape Town, interconnected with South Africa's TENET and SANReN, and described it as ready and operational.

MZ News reports that on 20 February 2026 Mozambique's communications minister launched the Mozambique-Zambia Interconnectivity Project at Cassacatiza, a cross-border fibre partnership of Vodacom Moçambique and Bayobab Zambia with both countries' regulators involved.
